summary: Intrusion Inc. filed an 8-K to report its acquisition of 100% of OW Cyber LLC from VigilAigent Corp. in two closings. At First Closing on June 29, 2026, it acquired 60% for $1.95 million, paid via $200K deposit credit, $160K cash, and $1.59M in unregistered common stock at $0.67 per share. Second Closing for remaining 40% is $1.3M cash, subject to stockholder and Nasdaq approval by August 30, 2026. A post-closing working capital adjustment applies. The company became initial Manager of Target. Watch for regulatory approvals and stockholder vote risks.
